description: v4 only. Quote paying down a borrow using supplied collateral, atomically and without the funds leaving Aave. 'debtPosition' is the borrow to reduce, a positionItemId from get_position_items with side=borrow whose 'quotableAs' lists repayDebt; 'repayWithReserve' is the reserveId of the collateral that pays for it, from get_markets with 'quotableAs' listing repayWith, on the same spoke. Use this instead of withdraw-swap-repay by hand: it is one atomic step, so the health factor never dips in between. The quoteId feeds prepare_order. Nothing is committed until the user signs, so state the plan rather than asking permission to quote it.

amount.description: Amount of debt to repay, in main units, e.g. '100.5'.

debtPosition.description: positionItemId of the borrow to reduce (get_position_items side=borrow).

repayWithReserve.description: reserveId of the collateral that pays for it (from get_markets).

slippagePct.description: Optional max slippage as a percent string, e.g. '0.5'. Omit to accept the backend suggestion.

version.description: Optional, and only 'v4': this tool exists on v4 only.

name: get_repay_with_supply_quote
title: Quote repaying debt from collateral (v4)
